issue.body:
Reproducer: https://godbolt.org/z/Ebece6co7
Testcase:
```c
#include <stdint.h>
#define BS_VEC(type, num) type __attribute__((vector_size(num * sizeof(type))))
int16_t backsmith_pure_2(uint64_t BS_ARG_1, uint16_t BS_ARG_5) {
  uint16_t BS_VAR_2;
  BS_VEC(int32_t, 16)
  BS_VAR_3 = __builtin_convertvector(
      (BS_VEC(uint64_t, 16)){BS_ARG_1, BS_ARG_1, BS_ARG_1, BS_ARG_1, BS_ARG_1,
                             BS_ARG_1, BS_ARG_1},
      BS_VEC(int32_t, 16));
  BS_VAR_2 = BS_ARG_5 >= (_BitInt(75))BS_VAR_3[6];
  return BS_VAR_2;
}
```

```ll
define signext range(i16 0, 2) i16 @backsmith_pure_2(i64 noundef %BS_ARG_1, i16 noundef zeroext %BS_ARG_5) {
entry:
  %conv16 = zext i16 %BS_ARG_5 to i75
  %vecext = trunc i64 %BS_ARG_1 to i32
  %conv17 = sext i32 %vecext to i75
  %cmp = icmp sge i75 %conv16, %conv17
  %conv18 = zext i1 %cmp to i16
  ret i16 %conv18
}
```
